transformTemplates: {"releases": [$[draft = false and prerelease = false and $count(assets[name in ["pi-darwin-arm64.tar.gz", "pi-linux-arm64.tar.gz", "pi-linux-x64.tar.gz"] and $type(digest) = "string" and $contains(digest, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)]) = 3].{"version": $substring(tag_name, 1), "digest": $substring(assets[name = "pi-{{packageName}}.tar.gz"].digest, 7), "releaseTimestamp": published_at, "changelogUrl": html_url}], "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/earendil-works/pi"}

{"releases": [$[draft = false and prerelease = false and $contains(tag_name, /^v[0-9]{4}\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/)].($release := $; $names := ["mise-" & tag_name & "-macos-arm64.tar.gz", "mise-" & tag_name & "-linux-arm64-musl.tar.gz", "mise-" & tag_name & "-linux-x64-musl.tar.gz"]; $valid := assets[name in $names and $type(digest) = "string" and $contains(digest, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)]; $count($valid) = 3 and $count($distinct($valid.name)) = 3 ? {"version": $substring(tag_name, 1), "digest": $substring($valid[name = "mise-" & $release.tag_name & "-{{packageName}}.tar.gz"].digest, 7), "releaseTimestamp": published_at, "changelogUrl": html_url})], "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/jdx/mise"}
